speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I understand you are experiencing right leg weakness, an unsteady gait, multiple falls, forgetfulness, and paranoid behavior. To help me determine the cause, how long have these symptoms been present, and have you noticed any changes in your speech or vision?

speaker: Patient
text: 44-year-old male. The patient's daughter reports a 1-week history of right leg weakness, unsteady gait, and multiple falls. Over the past 6 months, the patient has been increasingly forgetful, losing his way on familiar routes and facing difficulties operating simple kitchen appliances. He has also been paranoid, agitated, and restless recently.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Subacute Combined Degeneration of the Spinal Cord (likely due to Vitamin B12 deficiency) or early-stage Paraneoplastic Syndrome (e.g., Anti-Hu associated with Small Cell Lung Cancer).

REQUEST TEST: Serum Vitamin B12, Folate, Complete Blood Count, and Paraneoplastic Panel (Anti-Hu, Anti-Yo).
REQUEST IMAGES: MRI Cervical and Thoracic Spine, Whole Body CT.
